scope: llvm-bitcode members only. Native-ELF members have ZERO allowance.
authority: sdk/notes/work/PROTOCOL.md section 5, gate tier-2 (declared toolchain baseline).
reason: The reference archive's bitcode was produced by clang 17.0.2 build 11349228 (based on r487747e); the pinned NDK 26.1.10909125 toolchain is clang 17.0.2 build 10552028 (based on r487747d). Same major/minor, different point build. The reference compiler materialises the std::length_error vtable/typeinfo COMDAT into every C++ TU that can throw; the pinned compiler only imports it. Consequence: a byte-faithful source rebuild still shows two extra undefined symbols relative to the reference object. This is a toolchain point-version difference, not a source or behaviour difference.
hard_rules: T (defined strong/weak text) symbol sets MUST be empty both ways. No allowance ever.
U (undefined) symbol sets: missing-from-rebuild may only contain entries listed in uMissing below; extra-in-rebuild must be empty or explained per member in its metadata.
W (weak) symbols are informational only; report them, do not gate on them (AGENTS: ACCEPTANCE.md V2 only compares T).
An entry here may NOT be used to hide a missing implementation path. If a rebuild is missing a symbol that the reference calls, and that symbol is not in this list, the member fails.
Every allowance must be reproducible: the gate output must show raw diff AND baseline-adjusted diff, plus how many allowance entries were actually consumed.

The eight bionic/libc++/exception-runtime entries below were added after the member gate attributed 38 of 39 'complete' failures to them with an empty T diff. They are import-set only; a missing kit API symbol is never allowed here.

Entries with class 'reference-declared-unused' are scoped by `applies_to` (member idx) and `layout`; they cover symbols the reference object declares without a reachable call site (dead code kept by the producer, declaration-only entries, or header-inline copies the rebuild inlines). They must carry `evidence`, may name a native-ELF member explicitly, and may never contain a kit API symbol (kernel_module::*, skroot_env::*, kernel_root::*, maplesu_*).
